headline: MBBS-Trained Physician | Clinical Consultant for EHR Workflow, Training and Change
summary: MBBS-trained physician with emergency medicine, ICU and occupational health practice and four years as Clinical Advisor at Greenway Health, a US EHR company. I assess clinical practices and workflows, design practice-specific EHR workflows, and design and deliver training to clinical staff (200+ users trained). On Greenway's Patient Safety Committee and Clinical Content Team I triaged patient-safety issues through release and reviewed clinical literature for evidence-based EHR content. I led clinical input on a new AI-first EHR, from provider personas to end-to-end workflow maps.
greenway_bullets: Owned end-to-end EHR implementations for close to 200 client practices, from discovery and workflow documentation through configuration, setup and adoption.
Ran discovery with each practice to document pain points, business processes and goals, then designed and configured practice-specific workflows and widgets.
Trained 200+ end users, including providers, nurse practitioners, nurses and medical assistants, on the new workflows.
Turned recurring client pain points into feature requests and worked with product teams to get them built; many shipped to clients.
Triaged defects and patient safety issues from detection through stage-gate release as a member of the Patient Safety and Functional Advisory Committees.
Clinical lead for a new AI-first EHR from Aug 2025: defined provider personas, mapped end-to-end clinical workflows and built React prototypes before engineering handoff.
Presented to clients and at the Greenway Engage provider conference.
skills: clinical needs assessment, clinical workflow analysis, change management, stakeholder engagement
clinical training design and delivery, SOP writing, clinical staff education
patient safety, evidence-based practice, clinical content review, EHR and health informatics
thesis_html: A physician's eye on clinical change, with four years inside an EHR company.
why_fit: Clinical practice in a Level 1 trauma centre and a COVID ICU.
Two client organisations assessed; 200+ clinical staff trained.
Patient Safety Committee and Clinical Content Team at Greenway.
